name: Flagstaff
feature_notes: The Admiral can continue with the remembered sign-in email, edit it at the password step, or forget it on this device.

backend_prerequisite.reason: Existing Countercraft backend is active; this build requires idle-v1 service and SQL upgrade before customer kiosk use. No Ike publication configured at read-only audit. Old service is rejected by kiosk.

install_step: Open Admiral My Fleet on the iPad. After the PIN, check that the remembered email offers one sign-in. Continue to see Edit my sign-in email.
